text: Pre-fix evidence: five fresh renders currently pass, confirming the historical crash is invocation-sensitive rather than deterministic. Purl execution still emits missing-coefficient, IVW-fallback, and weighted-Fisher warnings; t-only fits report method='pm' instead of the requested combination; spatial FDR rejects 75 voxels (27 true active, 48 inactive). Added fmri_meta/meta-method implementation paths to the reservation.
